comment: expect: 'ok' or the ErrorCodes value the loader must report

cases.note: Smallest accepted manifest.
Every optional field, a prerelease+build version, a dependency and an optional dependency.
schemaVersion is required.
Only schemaVersion 1 is supported.
schemaVersion must be a number.
id is required.
A required string that is only whitespace is rejected.
Mod ids cannot contain path separators.
Version must be full SemVer major.minor.patch.
SemVer forbids leading zeros.
Absolute paths are rejected.
Path traversal is rejected.
Separators are rejected, so a manifest can never point outside the package.
The entry assembly must be a .dll.
schemaVersion 1 rejects unknown fields so typos cannot be silently ignored.
version must be a string.
Version ranges require full SemVer comparators.
The same dependency twice is rejected.
A mod cannot depend on itself.
More than 64 dependencies is rejected.
The manifest root must be a JSON object.
Duplicate object keys are rejected instead of silently keeping the last one.
Trailing commas are not valid JSON.
Latin-1 bytes are not UTF-8.
Manifests larger than 256 KiB are rejected before parsing.
